category.name: Watermark
category.preferred_workflow: Prefer the high-level Document.Watermark.SetText and SetImage overloads that accept a file path or a stream together with TextWatermarkOptions or ImageWatermarkOptions. When a cell-level watermark is required, insert a Shape into the target cell and configure its wrap and alignment properties. Always create deterministic input files (documents, PNG images) in the local folder before loading them, and save the resulting document to a known location for validation.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference members that are not present in Aspose.Words 26.11.0, such as WatermarkLayout members, ImageWatermarkOptions inside the Watermark type, or System.Drawing APIs for image generation.
canonical_patterns: Use Document.Watermark.SetText(string, TextWatermarkOptions) for customizable text watermarks.
Use Document.Watermark.SetImage(string, ImageWatermarkOptions) or the stream overload for image watermarks.
For table-cell watermarks, create a Shape, set WrapType to None, and append it to the cell's first paragraph.
nullable_warning_prevention: Validate that all objects passed to Watermark methods are non-null and of the expected type before invoking the API.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: The compiler reports CS1503 because a string, FileStream, or MemoryStream is supplied where an SKBitmap is required, leading to runtime ArgumentNullException.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Code passes file paths or generic streams directly to SetImage instead of providing an SKBitmap instance or using the overload that accepts a file path.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use the overload Document.Watermark.SetImage(string imagePath, ImageWatermarkOptions) or convert the stream to an SKBitmap before calling SetImage.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always select the overload that matches the input type and avoid implicit conversions; consult the API reference for accepted parameter types.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0246 errors indicate that Table, Cell, Row, or related types cannot be resolved, causing build failures.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The required namespace Aspose.Words.Tables is omitted from the using directives.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Add "using Aspose.Words.Tables;" and, when needed, "using System.Drawing;" for color definitions.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Include all necessary Aspose.Words namespaces at the top of the file before referencing table-related classes.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0426 and CS0117 errors show that TextWatermarkOptions, ImageWatermarkOptions, or WatermarkLayout members are not found within the Watermark type.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code treats Watermark as a namespace and attempts to access option types that belong to the Aspose.Words.Drawing namespace.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Reference Aspose.Words.Drawing and instantiate TextWatermarkOptions or ImageWatermarkOptions directly; use WatermarkLayout from the same namespace.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Follow the documented pattern: var options = new TextWatermarkOptions { FontFamily = "Arial", FontSize = 48, Color = Color.Blue, Layout = WatermarkLayout.Diagonal };

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Misuse of Watermark as a namespace and overbroad validation
common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0138 errors arise from using "using Watermark;" and validation code checks unrelated document internals.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Developers incorrectly add a using directive for the Watermark class and write validation that inspects unrelated nodes.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove the erroneous using directive and limit validation to checking the existence of the watermark and the output file.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Treat Watermark as a static class accessed via Document.Watermark and keep validation scoped to the task's output.

narrative.overview: The Watermark category demonstrates how to apply text and image watermarks to Word documents using Aspose.Words 26.11.0. Verified examples show correct usage of Document.Watermark APIs for document-wide, table-cell, and stream-based scenarios.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding agent with clear guidance to generate reliable watermark code that respects Aspose.Words APIs, creates any required sample assets, and validates only the presence of the expected watermark output.
validation_priorities: Confirm that the output file exists and that Document.Watermark.ContainsWatermark returns true for the expected WatermarkType.
maintenance_notes: Update example images to a minimal embedded PNG to avoid external dependencies.
Periodically verify that the Watermark API signatures have not changed in newer Aspose.Words releases.
Ensure that all sample code includes explicit using directives for Aspose.Words.Drawing and Aspose.Words.Tables.
